name: Minecraft: Golem World
summary: Golem World is a Minecraft mod for versions 1.6.x to 1.7.2+ that adds a variety of new golems, each made from different blocks like ice, redstone, obsidian, and more. Each golem has its own behavior or ability, such as emitting redstone signals, freezing enemies, or creating light. Golems are built using the standard Iron Golem shape and activated with a crafted item called the Paper of Awakening. The mod is open source, compatible with Forge, and requires iChunUtil.
